title: Zarankiewicz’s complete-bipartite crossing conjecture
statement: For all m,n, the crossing number of K_(m,n) equals floor(m/2)·floor((m−1)/2)·floor(n/2)·floor((n−1)/2).

counterexample.description: A general-position rational straight-line drawing of K_(m,n) below the Zarankiewicz value; K_(7,11) below 225 or K_(9,9) below 256 are early unresolved targets.
